text_block_list.text:
Today is the "Fan Appreciation Festival," 
where Umamusume express their daily 
gratitude to the fans who support them—

Events hosted by the Umamusume were taking 
place all across Tracen Academy.

Upon visiting the training course, which 
seemed noticeably lively...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer-kun!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer-chan!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Could it be you came to see just how 
awesome I look?"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Fufu, to tell the truth—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Mmm... What should I do...?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
What's the matter? Look at you, all 
troubled.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
There's a slight problem with one of the 
Fan Thanksgiving events.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
An opening opened up in the program that 
uses the training track.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean we don't have enough 
attractions?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Mm, I had prepared several races, but 
everyone has been too busy, and I couldn't 
gather enough students.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hey! If that's the case, I have a great 
idea!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
And so, I came up with an event that gets 
everyone hyped up, with fans participating 
too!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
We'll open up the track where spectators 
normally can't go and let everyone right 
in!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"And right in the center, me and my junior 
will put on a show! Sounds totally hype, 
right?"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I got the idea from those "pedestrian zone 
street lives" that are all the rage with 
the hip young crowd~!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you don't know? You're so out of the 
loop~! The younger crowd is gonna leave 
you behind, you know?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Now, this is guaranteed to drive everyone 
wild with fever, so feast your eyes!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Maruzen-san! The "podium" is all ready to 
gooo!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: F-Fluffy fans have been prepared too...!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Okay! Let's get started then...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Tracen, Tokyo!

Maruzensky and the others climbed up onto 
the podium and began grooving and dancing 
along to the techno beats.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Everyone's gonna get so hyped~! Whew♪
And the fans who had gathered—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
How nostalgic... Those days were truly so 
much fun...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
There was a time when I got carried away 
like that, too...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh...? Why did things suddenly get so 
nostalgic!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for reminding me of the fun 
times.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Y-You're welcome...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: No, let's get into the groove! Fe-Fever~!

While the excitement wasn't quite what was 
expected, the performance was very well 
received by a certain group of people.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to Maruzensky, this is 
definitely it!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Just as I expected~! It brings back 
memories of those days and really gets me 
pumped up~! Fever♪

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Whoaa...! Everyone looks like they're 
having so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice will wave her fluffy folding fan and 
do her best too...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa! Seeing everyone having this much 
fun... I'm so moveddddd!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I don't really get why everyone's so 
hyped, but that's Maruzen-san for you!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Why? Because dancing on the podium is all 
the rage for modern ladies!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Everyooone, let's get even more hyped! 
Whoo!
(WAAAAAHHH~~~~!!)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, it seems leaving it to Maruzensky 
was the right call.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Especially that fluffy fan... It shows 
really great fan-cy taste... Hehehe.

And so, Maruzensky's performance came to a 
close with huge success.
